exec: pm.test('presigned URL request returns HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('response is a PUT URL for coupon.json in the coupons bucket', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.method).to.eql('PUT'); pm.expect(body.bucket).to.eql('coupons'); pm.expect(body.key).to.eql('coupon.json'); pm.expect(body.upload_url).to.include('/coupons/coupon.json'); pm.expect(body.upload_url).to.include('X-Amz-Signature='); pm.collectionVariables.set('upload_url', body.upload_url); });
pm.test('upload with presigned URL returns HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('S3 returns an ETag for the uploaded object', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('ETag')).to.be.a('string'); });
